title: Belrose Circle Points Redemption Value Table
content:
# Belrose Circle Points Redemption Value Table

One point held under the Belrose Circle Membership Programme is worth, when spent, the value its tier fixes; the tier also fixes the fewest points that may be spent in one redemption, the block size points are spent in, the channels through which points may be spent, and whether points may be given to another member or pooled with a member at the same address.

## Table

| Tier | Value of one point when spent | Fewest points in one redemption | Block size | Channels | Points may be given to another member | Points may be pooled within the household |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Belrose Circle Member | 1.0 cent | 2500 | 500 | in store | No | No |
| Belrose Circle Silver | 1.1 cents | 2000 | 500 | in store | No | No |
| Belrose Circle Gold | 1.2 cents | 1500 | 250 | in store; online portal | No | Yes |
| Belrose Circle Platinum | 1.35 cents | 1000 | 250 | in store; online portal | Yes | Yes |
| Belrose Circle Black | 1.5 cents | 500 | 100 | in store; online portal; by telephone with an agent | Yes | Yes |
| Belrose Circle Founders' Club | 2.0 cents | 250 | 50 | in store; online portal; by telephone with an agent; through the concierge | Yes | Yes |

## Points of reading

- **One point when spent** is worth 1.0 cent at Belrose Circle Member, 1.1 cents at Belrose Circle Silver, 1.2 cents at Belrose Circle Gold, 1.35 cents at Belrose Circle Platinum, 1.5 cents at Belrose Circle Black and 2.0 cents at the Belrose Circle Founders' Club.
- **Fewest points and block size.** A redemption is never smaller than the tier's fewest points and is made up of whole blocks of the tier's block size. At Belrose Circle Member the fewest is 2500 points in blocks of 500; at Belrose Circle Silver 2000 in blocks of 500; at Belrose Circle Gold 1500 in blocks of 250; at Belrose Circle Platinum 1000 in blocks of 250; at Belrose Circle Black 500 in blocks of 100; at the Belrose Circle Founders' Club 250 in blocks of 50.
- **Channels.** Belrose Circle Member and Belrose Circle Silver spend points in store only. Belrose Circle Gold and Belrose Circle Platinum spend in store or through the online portal. Belrose Circle Black adds spending by telephone with an agent, and the Belrose Circle Founders' Club adds spending through the concierge.
- **Transfer and pooling.** Points are given to another member only at Belrose Circle Platinum, Belrose Circle Black and the Belrose Circle Founders' Club. Points are pooled with a member at the same address at Belrose Circle Gold, Belrose Circle Platinum, Belrose Circle Black and the Belrose Circle Founders' Club, and not at Belrose Circle Member or Belrose Circle Silver.

## Block illustrations (hypothetical)

- At Belrose Circle Gold, 1500, 1750 and 2000 points are each a permissible redemption size; 1600 points is not a whole number of 250-point blocks, and 1250 points is below the fewest points of 1500.
- At the Belrose Circle Founders' Club, 250 points is the smallest redemption and 300 points is the next size above it.
